name: Urusei Yatsura: Endless Summer
original_name: うる星やつら エンドレスサマー
source:
In here you will basically find a rather usual Japanese dating simulation in which you will be controlling Ataru and move him across the many screens that compose the town you will be playing in. You can enter some houses, talk to people you find around the scenario and even collect some items, all by simply moving your character to the place where the house/person/item is.

When you enter a house or you get in touch with a person you will usually spot a small event sequence, in which your character will talk to someone else and sometimes more things may occur, like you having to play a mini-game (which are always really easy to play) and even increasing how much a specific girl likes you.

[From [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/ds/925570-urusei-yatsura-endless-summer/reviews/98251]Mykas0 review[/url]]
translation:
本作基本上是一款较为传统的日式恋爱模拟游戏。玩家操控阿当，在组成小镇的多个画面间移动。你可以进入部分住宅，与场景中遇到的人交谈，也能收集物品；只需把角色移动到相应房屋、人物或物品所在的位置即可。

进入住宅或接触人物后，通常会触发一小段事件，角色会与他人交谈，有时还会发生更多事情，例如需要进行始终十分简单的小游戏，或提高某位少女对你的好感。

[摘自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/ds/925570-urusei-yatsura-endless-summer/reviews/98251]Mykas0的评测[/url]]
